svg.title: Graphic 10.1 — Two Senses, Two Directions
svg.desc: Side-view Zumo photograph supplied by the user. The original transparent PNG is embedded byte-for-byte without resampling, recompression, cropping, or redrawing. The instructional overlays compare downward-looking line sensors with a forward-looking proximity sensor.
svg.text: SIDE VIEW — the robot is about to hit something it cannot see
sitting ON TOP of the line
Zumo 32U4 side view · driving this way →
“Is there a line beneath me?” — YES. All is well.
“Is there a wall in front of me?” — the question nobody asked.
They read the mat, 5 times across, pointing straight
down at the tape. That is the only direction they look.
// line is still there. Everything is fine.
And it is right. The line really is still there.
It is right about the wrong thing.
It fires infrared out of the nose and counts how much
bounces back. Nothing ahead → 0. A block ahead → 6.
Both sensors are telling the truth at the same time.
Deciding which one WINS is this lesson.
Side-view Zumo image supplied by the user.
